$comment: The 32 lines of banter version 1 (git HEAD before docs/PLAN-help-footer.md): the v2 conversion must keep every one under its key.

lines.text: Full magician. Remember: the astral sees you too.
A million nuyen and a head full of chrome. Try not to rust before your first run.
Five thousand nuyen. That's a pistol and a prayer, chummer.
Under two Essence. The street docs call that 'held together by warranty'.
Every piece of chrome you put in costs the mana you had. Ask the shamans who traded theirs for a smartlink.
Chrome's forever. The warranty isn't.
Buy the gun you can afford to throw in the river.
Armor jacket. Boring. Alive. Pick one.
Your ride is your getaway, your office and occasionally your coffin. Spend accordingly.
A deck's only as good as the code on it. And the decker's only as good as their nerve.
Human. Nothing special — which is exactly why nobody remembers your face. Use that.
Pointy ears open doors uptown and close them in the Barrens. Know which street you're on.
Dwarves see in the dark and shrug off what kills the rest of us. Short jokes are fatal. Mostly for the joker.
Tusks and a short fuse are what they expect. Give 'em a long memory instead.
Doorframes are your natural enemy. Everything else is just scared of you.
New face on the board. Pick a handle you can live with, chummer. Your government name? Keep it in a lead box.
Second the lead box. I've seen SINs sold for less than a soykaf.
Five letters, A through E, and every one of 'em costs you something. Welcome to the shadows.
Put Resources on E and you'll be eating Nutrisoy out of a dumpster behind the Stuffer Shack. Ask me how I know.
Put Magic on A and the street will smell it on you before you open your mouth. Worth it.
Pick your meat. You'll be stuck in it a while.
Awakened? Then hear this: the drain doesn't care how pretty your spell looks.
Totem or tradition, choose like your life depends on it. It will.
Body keeps you breathing. Quickness keeps you out of the way. Nobody ever died of too much Willpower.
Can't shoot, can't talk, can't drive? Then you'd better be able to run. Fast.
Etiquette is the cheapest armor in the Sprawl. Nobody buys it.
Everybody's got a flaw. The smart ones know which one will get 'em killed.
Nuyen in your pocket at the start is the most nuyen you'll ever have. Spend it like it's your last.
Your fixer is not your friend. Your fixer is your fixer. Learn the difference before you learn it the hard way.
Low lifestyle: you'll learn which neighbours to trust. Squatter: you'll learn which ones to run from.
Board's open. Don't make me write your obituary on it.
Frag it, I'll write it. I've got a template.
